nom: INIA Red Light Therapy Mask for Face

avis.titre: Spa-Quality Red Light Therapy at Home
avis.texte: I’ve been really impressed with this NIA Red Light Therapy Mask. It’s comfortable to wear, lightweight, and the adjustable fit makes it easy to use while relaxing or doing things around the house. The rechargeable battery lasts through multiple sessions, and I appreciate the timer and auto shut-off so I don’t have to keep an eye on the clock. The different light modes are a great feature, allowing me to customize each treatment. After a few weeks of consistent use, my skin looks healthier, smoother, and more radiant. My complexion appears more even, and my skin feels firmer and well-rested. The build quality feels premium, and the mask is simple to use right out of the box. If you’re looking for an easy way to add LED light therapy to your skincare routine from the comfort of home, this mask is a fantastic investment.

I’ve been using this for about 2 months now and have seen a huge difference in my skin. I was breaking out horribly for about 3 months and decided to give this a try. My skin is finally looking back to normal. I was pleasantly surprised given the price at how well it works! The only complaint I have is it doesn’t stay on my face very well. The Velcro strap is meh, so I usually lay down to use it. The eye holes also don’t line up very well. But I can say, this thing works.

avis.titre: Visible Results Next Day- Great Buy for Price!!
avis.texte: Look no futher, I did a slightly ridiculous amount of research before choosing this mask because the red-light therapy market is absolutely saturated with options. After comparing the number of lights, wavelengths, features, fit, battery life, and price, I decided on the INIA and I’m very happy with my choice. The mask fits my face well and provides good, even coverage without feeling awkward. It has an impressive number of lights for the price, and the rechargeable battery holds a charge well, so I’m not constantly plugging it back in. I use the red light with the near-infrared (NIR) feature on High mode. After my very first session, my skin looked smoother and more even, and my pores appeared noticeably smaller. I wasn’t expecting such an immediate visible difference, but it was obvious enough that I kept checking my skin throughout the day. Of course, skincare results can vary, and I’m interested to see what consistent use does over time. Based on the fit, light coverage, battery performance, price, and my initial results, this mask has exceeded my expectations. It feels like a genuinely good value in a very crowded market.

avis.titre: A great addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: I’ve been using this mask for a little while now, and so far I’m very impressed. I’ve noticed a visible improvement in my skin’s elasticity, especially when using the red + blue light setting. My skin feels firmer and looks healthier. The mask was easy to set up, and the controls are simple to figure out. One of my favorite features is that I can wear it while doing things around the house instead of having to sit still for the entire treatment. For the price, I honestly wasn’t expecting this level of quality, but it has exceeded my expectations. While it’s still early, the results I’ve seen so far have been encouraging, and I’m excited to continue using it. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an affordable red light therapy mask. I will add that the Velcro does tend to pull your hair if you get it caught, however I throw my hair in a ponytail and it’s eliminated the problem.

avis.titre: My New Favorite Part of My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I absolutely love this LED face mask! I’ve added it to my skincare routine along with my favorite creams and peptides, and it has quickly become one of my favorite self-care steps. The mask feels very well made, and I especially love having different light modes, including red light and NIR. It’s also rechargeable, which makes it so convenient because I can use it comfortably without having to stay next to an outlet. I usually use it as part of my evening skincare routine, and I love how easy it is to incorporate into my day. The timer is another feature I really appreciate—I can relax, let it do its thing, and it automatically shuts off when the session is finished. I’ve been very consistent with it because it’s actually enjoyable to use. Between this mask, my skincare products, and my peptides, my routine now feels like my own little at-home spa treatment. 😂 Beautiful design, convenient, comfortable, and easy to use. I’m genuinely happy with this purchase and definitely look forward to continuing to use it consistently. If you love skincare and self-care as much as I do, this is such a nice addition to your routine

Bought this for my hormonal acne and it's helped a good bit, redness has calmed down a lot. Takes patience tho, dont expect miracle results in like 2 days. Ive been doing 10 min sessions after i wash my face and my skin texture feels smoother already. Battery life is decent and I am happy with the product .

I’ve been really enjoying the INIA. It’s easy to use, comfortable on my face, and the 850nm NIR light makes it feel like a more advanced skincare treatment at home. After using it consistently, my skin looks brighter, smoother, and more refreshed. I love that I can enjoy a spa-like treatment without leaving home. Definitely worth trying if you’re looking to upgrade your skincare routine!
Squished nose, very uncomfortable. Wish I could trade in or get refund and but the one that doesnt smash the nose

Diese LED-Maske hat meine Erwartungen absolut übertroffen! Die Verarbeitung wirkt hochwertig, und sie liegt angenehm auf der Haut, ohne zu drücken. Nach einigen Anwendungen habe ich bereits bemerkt, dass meine Haut frischer, glatter und strahlender aussieht. Besonders gefällt mir, dass es verschiedene Lichtmodi gibt, die sich leicht umschalten lassen, sodass ich gezielt auf unterschiedliche Hautbedürfnisse eingehen kann. Die Nutzung ist einfach und entspannt, perfekt für eine kleine Wellness-Auszeit zuhause. Der Akku hält zuverlässig, und die Reinigung ist unkompliziert. Für alle, die ihre Hautpflege auf das nächste Level bringen möchten, eine klare Kaufempfehlung!

I’ve been using this for around 4/5 months now and I absolutely love it. I was skeptical at first but found it here on offer and figured it was worth a shot. My skin has cleared up massively. I was suffering with acne before and it has really calmed my skin, I also noticed my dark spots from acne scarring has gone now too. It’s easy to use, just a quick wipe down before use and after then you’re good to go. The charge lasts a decent amount of time too. The fit is a little awkward on the eyes but doesn’t affect it too much.

avis.titre: Bien pour l’acné avec led bleue
avis.texte: J’ai acheté ça pour ma fille ado de 14 ans qui a de l’acné. Mais à n’utiliser que en lumière bleue. Ça fait que quelques jours mais j’ai l’impression que ça va mieux. Moins de rougeur. À voir dans le temps. Mais moins cher que les masques haut de gamme et pourtant confortable à porter.

I’ve been using this mask for over a month now, combining all the modes every single day, and my skin is looking great! My face looks brighter, I haven’t experienced any irritation, and it’s really easy to use. I think it meets all my needs. It’s definitely worth the money, and it works! Also, the face mask is a little bit bigger than the average face, so you’ll need to lie down or stay still while using it. I personally don’t mind at all. When I put the mask on, I love to meditate or listen to music, so I’ll be lying down or staying still either way. 😊

avis.titre: Light and very comfortable unlike other brands
avis.texte: No, I can’t tell you how well it works, but I can tell you that it is so comfortable. I bought previously one of the hard plastic masks and I find it so uncomfortable and actually painful but this one is light and so comfortable. I’m excited to try this.

I have mixed feelings about the mask. There’s a lot of research out there saying what the benefits are. I feel like the quality of the bulbs was very good and it’s good for skin care. But the fit of this particular mask just did not work well for my face. It was hard to get it adjusted. I used it for about three weeks before I ultimately decided to return it. It seems like there was some improvement in texture and color of my skin, but I don’t know if it was just the placebo effect. It was very relaxing. I do think I would have kept it if it fit better.

avis.titre: A Staple in My Healthy Aging Routine
avis.texte: I’ve been using the INIA Glow 2 consistently as part of my evening skincare routine, and it’s become one of my favorite skincare devices. I love that it offers multiple light modes, but I primarily use the Red High + Near-Infrared (NIR) setting for healthy aging and overall skin support. The mask is comfortable to wear, easy to operate, and the built-in timer makes treatments effortless. After my sessions, I sometimes notice a little temporary pinkness in a few areas of my face, but it fades and has never been accompanied by burning or irritation. What I appreciate most is how easy it is to incorporate into my routine before applying the rest of my skincare. It’s become a relaxing self-care ritual that I actually look forward to each night.

avis.titre: Bad battery pack - No Customer Service
avis.texte: I bought the Inia Glow2 mask for my wife a few months ago and she used it a couple times. She got busy with other things and started using again in November and the controller got very hot and was afraid it would catch on fire. Switched USB and still the same. Even unplugged the battery pack is very hot and only lasts a few minutes. Obviously, the battery pack in the controller failed and I have been trying to get replaced for 3 weeks now. Their customer service is only through What's App and they only respond once every few days with another question. They now say they are waiting for approval but that was almost a week ago. Their 2 year warranty is worthless in my opinion because they do not stand behind their product. You may as well throw in the trash if it starts having problems. Customer service will only leave you frustrated until you give up and go away. I'm not even sure if the mask does what they claim because it didn't work long enough to really tell. Be wary.
Straps are way to short to go around the head. Always getting caught in my hair
Wow! I got this for a post surgical incision that was not healing well after two and a half months. I used this for only two weeks so far and the amount of healing is incredible!

The mask was great until the red light function quit working. I ordered it in Feb 2026 and stopped working July 2026. Update August 2026: I was contacted by INIA and offered a replacement mask. They asked some questions about what worked and what didn't. Then they sent me a new mask in a matter of days. They even upgraded my mask to the newest model. Because of this outstanding customer service, I am changing my rating. Fingers crossed this one lasts.

So I did a lot of research before picking out a red light mask that I thought would be great for myself and for my skin. I like the flexibility that this mask has not being one of those hard base masks. I like that I can walk around my house while wearing it. It’s very lightweight. With that being said, I have two downsides. For one the battery does not last very long. I’ve had it for about two weeks now and I’ve had to charge it twice per week. For two depending on what setting you have it on it’s a very hard to see out the eye sockets cause it’s not like it’s like full on protection with the eye barriers. When it’s on just the red light or the blue light it’s easy to see out and like do stuff while wearing it, but when it’s on the red and blue light at the same time, you can’t see anything.Overall, a good product.

avis.titre: My new favorite self-care routine at home
avis.texte: I’ve been using this LED mask for a few weeks now and I’m really happy with it so far. It’s easy to use and comfortable enough to wear while relaxing in the evening. I like that it has different light options, including red, stronger red, blue, and a red + blue combination, so I can switch between them depending on what I feel like using that day. The mask feels well made and the light isn’t too harsh. I usually wear it while watching TV or doing chores and it doesn’t bother my eyes. The battery life has also been good and lasts for several sessions before needing to recharge. Overall it’s been a nice addition to my at-home skincare routine!
I loved this mask. Easy to use and forms nicely to my face. Only problem is the cord is starting to fray after 3 months.
Great addition to my night time routine. So far I have been doing the mark every night for 10 minutes I. Addition to whole body Red light therapy My skin looks amazing. Greatest mask for the price.

Purchased this 8/21 on 2/14 I went to use it and all the red lights quit working..the blue lights are fine..I Purchased both the face and neck led red light masks in the same day..the neck didn't last 2 months before it quit working..the company did reach out too me n offered a full return or replacement..I did get a refund because my next RLT mask will be from a different company..the products were great when they worked, but for how much your paying for both vs. How long they work I would go with a different brand..the pics are showing i have it turned on the red light setting but none are working...

Overall the mask is good. Can’t beat the price for what it offers. It has options and different time settings, and easy to use. The head strap is awful though and the reason for 3 stars. It is one large Velcro back piece, which is not great for the way the skull is shaped. It causes the mask to be secure on top but then is loose on the bottom. This means you’re not getting the same pressure or direct light all over the face. It also tends to catch any fly away hairs and basically will rip them out if they get caught in the Velcro. I’m currently trying to find replacements for the back.

I am new to red light therapy, but I figured I’d give it a shot as I struggle with hormonal cystic acne. My skin barrier is currently compromised from all the many changes to my skin care routine to help combat the outbreaks. So frustrating! The NIR option on red high for 20 minutes is already started to help soothe my skin and speed up the cell turnover/healing. It’s been a week and so far, I really love this mask. The battery life is great, it’s comfy and you can’t beat the price. My face feels more “alive” after I get done with each session. I know the acne part will take time I hope I start seeing some more noticeable results in the coming months!

i’ve only had it for about a week, and the only review i can give on this (only bc it’s too early for me to see results) is that it doesn’t fit my face at all. i have a smaller head and the whole time of me wearing it, im either adjusting it bc its slipping and pulling down on my ears or my skin too much. just not comfortable at all. the mouth section sits at my chin so it’s no ideal when i want to take a sip of water. other than that, i hope to see results from it!

avis.titre: Decent fit with plenty of light options
avis.texte: The product fit was okay, but not perfect. IT was comfortable enough for casual use. What stood out most were the multiple light settings, which made it versatile depending on the situation. The brightness levels and color options were a nice touch and worked as described. What I liked: - Good range of light modes to choose from - Works as expected for basic use - Reasonable quality for the price Could be better: -Fit could be a little more adjustable or snug, depending on head size Overall, it’s a solid pick if you’re looking for something functional with plenty of lighting variety at a fair price.

avis.titre: Simple and Comfortable LED Skincare Device
avis.texte: This LED light therapy mask is very easy to use and feels comfortable on the face. I like that it features different light modes and that the sessions are quick, so I can use it while resting or doing other things around the house. It’s a great way to incorporate technology into my daily skincare routine without any hassle
My only issue was getting it adjusted I feel like I can’t breathe while having it on, other than that really good product.

Mask looks very expensive and luxurious.It’s soft, flexible, odor-free, and feels very comfortable on the face. The mask is super easy to use, and I love that it has different light modes depending on what I want to target (red for anti-aging, blue for breakouts, etc.). The hook-and-loop strap is secure but gentle on my hair, which I really appreciate. The rechargeable battery works well and makes it super convenient to use without being tied to a plug. Great product for at-home skincare! I will recommend for everyone.

avis.titre: Dots on face after using mask (UPDATE)
avis.texte: I just used it, and I'm very concerned. Are the dots on my face from using the mask normal? *******UPDATE******* Changing my review from one to 5 stars. After my original post, Linda from INIA reached out due to the concern of discoloration. As a result they gave me a refund option, or to try a new product. After opting for the new option, it was sent right away. I like this new product much better than the old one for a few reasons: -Hand held and no cord, vs the mask where the cord was connected to the face mask -More controlled usage with it being hand held versus the mask where it did not fit that great on my face (the straps did not hold mask in place causing user to tighten it, leaving imprints) -this product doesn't touch your face (kept 1/2 inch away for 2 minutes, vs the mask where its fitted to your face for 5-10 minutes). The mask left discoloration for me -the LED lights aren't blinding versus the face mask where even though there are eye covers to minimize the glare, (snug piece to protect the eyes) the lights still glare through. I do appreciate Linda finding my feedback and reaching out to me. She took my concern seriously (along woth several people who notated concerns) and offered their resolution (retailoring product). I have not had any discoloration and find this new product much more comforting to use. The customer service was great and Linda was attentive to the concerns.

Like the different color options. Works nice. Cons: the eye openings are weird, whose eyes slant that much ? It digs into your eyes it doesn’t fit the face properly. Digs into the bridge of my nose leaving a red indent mark. The rubber smell is awful, will give you a headache if you pick more than 10 mins. 10 mins is tolerable but I can’t handle the smell.

I have been using this for about two weeks now and absolutely love it. I wear it at night in bed and it’s so relaxing before I go to sleep. I have definitely noticed a difference in the fine lines and wrinkles in my face. They are starting to look more subtle. I wear this for about 20 to 30 minutes a night while watching TV and it has been amazing.

This mask is very comfortable and easy to use. To use it, I just sat down on the sofa, put it on, and relaxed while the light worked on my face. It’s really user-friendly; you can adjust the timer and choose whether you want the blue light first, then the red, or just the red or just the blue. And after using it, I neatly stored it back in its box.

avis.texte: I really enjoyed the mask, but now it’s been two months and the cord is shorted out. I store it in the box it comes from but it still has a short and cuts off if I move.

avis.titre: Love this as part of my skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using this mask for a couple of weeks and I thought I'd need to use it for at least a month to see results, but I can already tell a difference in my skin. While I don't know that this would work well on its own, using this in tandem with a good skincare routine is probably the trick. After two weeks, my skin is softer and feels tighter, especially my forehead. I still have some lines, but they're pretty deep and I don't think this is a miracle worker. I look forward to my spa time though. After a shower, I lay down, put on some soothing spa music, and close my eyes while soaking in the light therapy. I don't recommend doing anything while using it, only because the eye cushions don't block out the red. So far, I'm loving adding this to my routine. This doesn't come with a storage case and I didn't want to keep the box, but it fits great inside a laptop sleeve.

avis.titre: Light therapy mask my wife is enjoying
avis.texte: First I have to give my wife credit for posing for me while actually wearing it, it does look kinda funny but does the job. So my wife had one of the small light therapy pens for awhile but she has really been wanting a full face mask so when I saw this it was an easy buy. She said it fits well and is easy to put on by herself. The mask has 4 different light modes including red L, red H, a blue, and a combination of them which is a violet color. The mask is powered by a battery on the controller and uses a USB C for charging. My wife also said to use serum on your face after using it. She is definitely happy with it so I would definitely recommend this since it's also decently priced compared to other similar light therapy masks.

Just recently getting into light therapy for my 44 year old skin, I didn't know what to expect going in. First, the mask looks so nice! Very high quality. The controller is high quality and not flimsy or overlooked. There are only a few buttons so it was pretty easy to figure out how to cycle through the lights and the timer. Charging took about 2 hours. The one thing to note if it's not obvious is not to go too tight on strapping it on. I did not realize and had redness on my nose solely due to how tight I strapped it. My entire face was covered and there is some overhang on the bottom part that seems to extend the light slightly which is nice. Other than that, after the 10 minute was up, it turned off by itself. I applied my night time serums and my skin felt and looked nicer already after the first use. I'm very excited to add this to my skincare arsenal!

I'm impressed with the quality of this mask. The initial presentation and box are nice as well. I find it comfortable to wear, although if you have a ponytail, it would need to be either high or very low to avoid the placement of the large tabs that are smack in the middle of the back of the mask and your head. The lights are very bright and seem powerful. The controller also seems to be of high quality, displaying all the modes as you cycle through and indicating the time of the treatment with a countdown. Although the controller is corded to the mask, it does not have to be plugged in to use, so you can move freely

This mask is very well made. The mask is very flexible and can be comfortably worn on my face. It’s great that the mask can improve my skin during my downtime when I am just watching a show or scrolling the phone. The control that comes with the mask is so easy to use with a very clear display of battery life and modes that the mask is currently set on. I like that it has not only red light in different wavelengths but also blue and a combination of red and blue light as well. The item also comes in a beautiful sleek box.

Arrived as pictured. Great shipping. Easy to use and I really liked the black color. The timer is nice to. Not only does it help your skin it seems too improve your mood. Not sure why but it sure did mine. Very relaxing and comforting. I'm a fan!~!~

avis.titre: Amazing results after just one use
avis.texte: Incredible and no skin irritation. It’s relaxing and comfortable to use. No eye discomfort. I use Red H and Blue/Red due to my age of 56. Yes, I wore it with my glasses so I could watch tv lol.

Very good quality, easy to use, I have been using this mask and is the best, and make your skin feel like new, very comfortable to wear, good materials and easy to learn the use, you can see in your skin the glow if you use the mask often, my skin is sensitive and worked so good.

RUN!!!! Don’t walk this mask is everything, battery life is great. it’s only been a week and my skin is noticeably brighter, and glowing. Stay consistent, I highly recommend this Mask. Affordable skincare in your own home.

avis.titre: Perfect red light mask and great results
avis.texte: Happy with my purchase. I have done a lot of research on red light masks, and this one seemed promising. There are 4 light modes including NIR and the high red is my favorite (brightest mode.) Only problem with it being so bright, the mask doesn’t seem to cover around the entire eye area even with the protective eye pads. Light seeps in, so I do wear my tanning goggles underneath (which are not included) It’s a little uncomfortable but does the job. I wouldn’t recommend not using something for the light. Keeping your eyes closed and laying down is the best result. I also don’t mind having the wired controller, since I do lay and relax it’s not an inconvenience. Charging is very quick and stands a charge for a pretty long time. You can control to use between 10, 20, and 30 mins. The mask itself is lightweight and I can feel it is working. My skin feels smooth and tighter. Great product and would recommend, minus the brightness eye issue I mentioned above.
Llevo poco tiempo pero me encanta, siento que hace su trabajo y cada día va mejorando mi piel. Recomendada, todo es de disciplina y usarla diario.
